title: 101 Switching Protocols
description:
RFC 9110 §15.2.2; class informational; engine use: conditional.
Trigger: Switching from HTTP/1.1 to the WebSocket protocol.
Content: none.
Required headers: Upgrade, Connection.
Cache-Control: none; retry: never.

x-response-contract.trigger: Switching from HTTP/1.1 to the WebSocket protocol.

Upgrade.value: websocket for 101; the required protocol token for 426.
Upgrade.notes: Must name a protocol the server is willing to switch to.

Connection.notes: Required with 101 and an Upgrade header.
